# Cost schedules: changes, evidence and effect (2026-11-15)

Scope held to the owner's instruction: only transaction-cost ground truth changed. No change to the research window, strategy logic, prices, corporate actions or any other VTI component.
**No schedule was marked VERIFIED.** The data files are regenerated by `scripts/build_cost_schedules.py`, which still refuses any quote not literally present in its stored document.

## What changed (owner decisions of 2026-11-15 applied)
| Item | Change |
|---|---|
| Exchange fee before 2021-01-01 | **0.00325%, ASSUMED** for every period (the NSE member tariff before NSE/FA/46730 was Rs 3.25 per lakh). It is an assumption about Zerodha's client rate, never VERIFIED. The temporary EQ-series concession (FA45147, FA47844, FA49796, FA51855) stays unresolved; no tariff calculation was added. |
| Exchange fee from 2021-01-01 | 0.00345%, dated by NSE/FA/46730 ("applicable with effect from January 01, 2021"); Zerodha's own notice of the client change was not found, stated as an assumption text. |
| DP charge until 2024-05-31 | **Rs 13.50, ASSUMED** (Rs 15.93 with GST from 2017-07-01). Evidence: Zerodha's founder on Zerodha's forum, March 2016 and September 2017 (stored in the lake); its continuation unchanged to May 2024 is the assumption. |
| DP charge 2024-06-01 to 2024-09-30 | **Rs 13 (Rs 15.34 with GST), ASSUMED.** Evidence: a Zerodha team member's forum reply (May 2024) relaying the CDSL 50-paise cut from 1 June 2024, and Zerodha's September 2024 bulletin (Rs 13 just before October 2024). No dated CDSL or Zerodha notice exists in hand. |
| DP charge from 2024-10-01 | Rs 15.34, extracted from the bulletin and the current page (not ASSUMED). |
| Schedule split | 2020-07-01 is split at 2021-01-01, and 2024-04-01 at 2024-06-01 (now 10 delivery schedules). |
| Component evidence | Five states (VERIFIED, EXTRACTED_UNVERIFIED, ASSUMED, UNAVAILABLE, NOT_APPLICABLE), independent of whether a document exists. A schedule is verifiable only when every component is VERIFIED or NOT_APPLICABLE; verifying one with ASSUMED/UNAVAILABLE components is refused even when its assumptions are accepted. |
| Legacy verified schedules | A schedule verified before components carried evidence still loads with its verifier and time, but with `verification_basis = LEGACY_SCHEDULE_LEVEL` and every component EXTRACTED_UNVERIFIED: a missing status is never read as proof. A schedule stating the evidence of only some components is rejected. `ScheduleCosts.describe()` lists legacy-verified schedules. None exists in the committed book. |
| Account scope | `account_scope: RESIDENT_INDIVIDUAL_RETAIL` on every schedule, validated. |
| DP once per scrip per debit day | `compute_charges(..., dp_already_charged=)`. The backtest engine tracks it per day; paper trading derives it from the persisted fills (a retry or replay cannot charge twice). Zerodha's own support page gives the same rule with a worked example (stored as a source). |
| Tests | Both sides of every rule change with hand-worked totals (including 2024-05-31/06-01); DP once per scrip per day (calculator, paper trading incl. replay, two scrips, two accounts, next day); evidence, legacy and account-scope rules; verification refusals. |

## Effect on the 17 stored backtests (same fills re-priced; read-only; `scripts/compare_cost_schedules.py`)
81,276 fills; the previous committed schedules reproduce all of them exactly (0 mismatches, with each run's recorded cost-stress factor), so the replay is faithful. Trade counts are identical by construction; strategies, prices and corporate actions were not touched (only cost-related paths changed).
| | Total cost | In the research window (from 2020-10-01) |
|---|---|---|
| Previous committed schedules | 8,875,602 | 7,775,306 |
| **Adopted (Rs 13.50 until 2024-05-31, then Rs 13)** | 8,902,255 (+0.30%) | 7,798,260 (+0.30%) |
| Scenario A (Rs 13 throughout, exchange fee as adopted) | 8,873,006 | 7,774,715 |
Adopted versus scenario A adds Rs 23,545 in the window. Per run, in-window costs rise by 0.06% to 1.25%. Estimated change in total return (the cost change taken off the final equity; no compounding): **between -0.03 and -1.62 percentage points**; the larger effects are on the Rs 100,000 accounts (runs 2, 3, 5, 6: -0.8 to -1.6, run 3 and 6 also being 2x-cost stress runs) and fall to about -0.03 to -0.2 on the Rs 1,000,000 and Rs 3,000,000 accounts. Per-run tables: `cost_comparison_2026-11-15.csv` (previous to adopted), `cost_comparison_dp_A_to_B_2026-11-15.csv` (A to adopted; its "old replay mismatched" column is expected there, because scenario A was never stored) and `cost_comparison_previous_to_dp_A_2026-11-15.csv`.
Roughly 40% of in-window fills carry at least one ASSUMED component, so none of these runs could support a promotion on these schedules.

## Open: the DP charge before 1 October 2024 stays ASSUMED
Both historical rates are labelled ASSUMED; the 1 June 2024 date is inferred from a forum reply and a news report, not a dated CDSL or Zerodha notice. When one is found it replaces the assumption, nothing else changes.

## Update: new primary evidence (same day), applied by the agent under the owner's standing goal
Zerodha's own charges page, archived by the Internet Archive on **2020-09-29** (stored in the lake as `zerodha_charges_wayback_2020_09_29`, sha256 `5c4c4aaceb48d4649f34eacfddf8372c491fa9a880cb19bbbce9b9413008b06b`), shows: transaction charges **NSE 0.00325%**, DP charges **Rs 13.5 + GST per scrip** (once a day per scrip, irrespective of quantity), **SEBI charges Rs 5 / crore**, GST "18% on (brokerage + transaction charges)" (no SEBI fee in the base), stamp 0.015% on the buy side. That page alone corrects or supports four things:
1. **SEBI turnover fee was halved from 1 June 2020 to 31 March 2021** (SEBI notification SEBI/LAD-NRO/GN/2020/011 of 8 May 2020, carried by NSE circular NSE/FA/44514, stored): Rs 5 per crore (0.00005%), not Rs 10. Zerodha billed Rs 5 until 4 May 2021 and then charged the April to May difference (a Zerodha staff reply on its forum), so the schedules use Rs 10 from 2021-04-01. The earlier schedules used Rs 10 throughout: an error of Rs 0.05 per Rs 1 lakh traded in those ten months.
2. **The exchange fee 0.00325% in July to December 2020 is now document-backed** (the page above), no longer ASSUMED; that it held for the whole of July to December is an inference, stated in the schedule's assumptions (NSE moved its member tariff on 1 January 2021).
3. **GST is not charged on the SEBI fee before July 2022**: Zerodha's own page bases GST on brokerage and transaction charges only, independent of the SEBI circular.
4. **DP Rs 13.50 is on Zerodha's page on that date**; the component stays ASSUMED for the other dates (a single dated point).

Schedules: 14 now (12 delivery incl. the new periods 2020-06-01..30, 2021-01-01..03-31 and 2021-04-01..2022-07-17, plus 2 intraday). Replay of the 17 stored runs against the previous commit: in-window cost -244 in total; estimated total return changes by at most 0.006 percentage points. The remaining Wayback snapshots (2021-04-11, 2022-01-17, 2023-12-24, 2024-04-30, 2024-06-16, 2024-11-02) were rate-limited; a slow background retry is running, and a good copy of 2024-04-30 and 2024-06-16 would date the Rs 13.50 to Rs 13 change from Zerodha's own page.

## Finding: the dev database already holds nine schedules VERIFIED by the owner (2026-11-12)
Found while trying to replace the old unverified schedules in the dev DB (the attempt failed before commit; **nothing was changed**). Eight delivery schedules (2016-01-01 onwards, contiguous) and one intraday are `verified`, by "Ilesh Patel" on 2026-11-12, through the portal. They were verified before components carried evidence, so they load as `LEGACY_SCHEDULE_LEVEL`: they keep the owner's record, their components are never read as individually verified, and **K1 no longer counts them** (K1 now reads the database, not the seed files, and counts only verification with component evidence).
Their content is the OLD content. Against the evidence found afterwards it differs in: the SEBI turnover fee (Rs 10 per crore throughout; it was Rs 5 from 2020-06-01 to 2021-03-31), the exchange fee before 2021 (0.00345% throughout; Zerodha's own page of 2020-09-29 shows 0.00325%), the DP charge (Rs 13 / Rs 15.34 throughout; Rs 13.50 / Rs 15.93 until 2024-05-31 on the owner-approved assumption), and the periods (the corrected files split at 2020-06-01, 2021-01-01, 2021-04-01 and 2024-06-01). The effect on the 17 stored backtests is small (+0.30% on in-window cost, up to -1.6 percentage points of estimated total return on the smallest accounts, mostly from the DP charge).
**A verified record is a person's attestation, and the store refuses to remove or re-verify one, so I did not replace them.** Decision for the owner: how to supersede a verified schedule that later evidence shows to be wrong (a new, audited `supersede` operation that keeps the old record and marks it superseded; or leave the legacy records and add the corrected periods after them). Until then studies keep using the legacy-verified content, and the corrected files in `config/cost_schedules` (14 schedules, none verified) are the proposal.

The schedules for 2021-01-01 onwards now cite it for the exchange fee (client-facing evidence of 0.00345% in 2021; that it began on 1 January is still an inference from NSE/FA/46730) and for the DP charge (a second dated point for Rs 13.50; the component stays ASSUMED across the range). Snapshots for 2022-01-17, 2023-12-24, 2024-04-30, 2024-06-16 and 2024-11-02 are still being retried slowly (the archive rate-limits); the 2024-04-30 and 2024-06-16 pair would date the Rs 13.50 to Rs 13 change from Zerodha's own page.
